程序包 org.bukkit.util.noise

类 SimplexOctaveGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.util.noise.OctaveGenerator
org.bukkit.util.noise.SimplexOctaveGenerator
public class SimplexOctaveGenerator extends OctaveGenerator
Creates simplex noise through unbiased octaves 通过无偏倍频创建单纯形噪声

    • setScale

      public void setScale(double scale)
      从类复制的说明: OctaveGenerator
      Sets the scale used for all coordinates passed to this generator.

      This is the equivalent to setting each coordinate to the specified value. 设置用于传给此生成器的所有坐标的缩放。

      这等价于将每个坐标设置为指定值。

      覆盖:
      setScale 在类中 OctaveGenerator
      参数:
      scale - New value to scale each coordinate by 缩放每个坐标的新值
